tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

TLS certificate verification is required on all builds, development builds included; no build configuration may disable it. This is the project's current recorded decision, and it is consistent with the project-wide policy of using HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exception.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

About three seconds later the user said not to use that workaround and that verification is needed on all builds, so the file records only the later position and leaves the workaround out.

The memory catalog has no formal decision entry for TLS verification. The wording rests on the user's statement, recorded as a transcript excerpt (#29) rather than a catalogued decision. The policy also notes that it fits the recorded "https everywhere, no plaintext exception" decision (#32).
